notation_updates.description: Lead-adopted notation changes for this exact account under project_notation_v1. The harness generates the complete lookup from the frozen incoming view and these additions; do not author a second glossary. Historical records may omit this field.

method_formulation_markdown.description: Fuller source-backed mathematical account of the exact implemented method from the frozen Phase 2 definition and inspected implementation: inputs, model relationships, fitting criterion or estimating rule, target/output and decisive conditions. Follow the supplied scientific-explanation reference. Define notation in context and use proper Markdown/LaTeX; the authored method_recap_markdown supplies the visible short recap. Do not invent mathematics or infer it from outcomes. No numerical display belongs here.

implementation_markdown.description: Briefly state what code was developed, revised or reused, what was actually tested on synthetic and supplied actual data, and any execution qualification consequential for interpretation. Name absence or unperformed work honestly. Cite implementation and result sources; the existing implementation and audit readers retain detailed checks. Keep the scientific numerical account, tables and figures in Experiments and Results.

method_fidelity_markdown.description: Short account for Implementation and Code: checked correspondence to the exact frozen Phase 2 method, consequential implementation choices, unresolved departures and verification gaps. Cite the analyst account and independent audit rather than repeating their full technical explanations. A completed run does not prove fidelity. Keep quantitative tables and figures in Experiments and Results.

explanation_markdown.description: Distinguish no applicable Phase 3 theory, available theory not tested, and empirical tests of named claims. Numerical agreement is not proof; identify contradictions and limitations.

conclusion_markdown.description: Give the fuller interpretation of the decisive supported observation and its boundary for the researcher goal, adding explanation beyond the first visible scientific_outcome.conclusion. Follow the supplied summary and claims-and-evidence references. Preserve applicable uncertainty, unsuccessful fits, inconclusive comparisons and synthetic/actual-data limits; absent benefit or nonsignificance does not establish no benefit or equivalence. Execution success is not scientific support. Link detail rather than replay every result.

tradeoff_markdown.description: Explain benefits and costs relevant to the researcher, distinguishing method runtime or memory from total evaluation budget. Preserve computational burden and uncertainty; a synthetic gain does not establish human benefit.

limitations_markdown.description: State consequential missing coverage, uncertain results, departures and attributed disagreement that limit the overall account.

recommendation_markdown.description: Recommend the next research or use decision with its evidence and resolving question, preserving researcher authorization.

coverage.description: Compose the primary numerical account from Analyst answers and inspected retained exhibits as a compact numerical experiments section, introducing design and measures before results. p4.exhibits is a required read: use its retained manifest and resolved attachment paths/digests to open the actual table files and inspect headers, cells, captions and mappings. Labels alone do not select source columns. Use native retained-file reads, not the publication-only preview. Select whole available displays and state an unresolved presentation limitation if needed; there is no ordinary return to a completed Analyst for cosmetic changes or authority to create replacement numerical evidence. Use synthetic_example, performance, computation, tuning, robustness and actual_data when supplied, with assessed/partial evidence or an explicit not_assessed/not_applicable reason. Keep the same study's conditions together when they answer one question, listing each interpreted exhibit in every applicable topic's exhibit_ids. The first coverage entry declaring it owns the display; later entries show a link. Put the intended primary entry first and keep placement instructions out of prose; do not require extra experiments to fill a topic.

dimension.description: Canonical topic for new accounts: synthetic_example, performance, computation, tuning, robustness, or actual_data. Historical labels remain readable without rewriting their records.

summary.description: The design or principal observed result that begins this part of the numerical section, with selected verified exhibits. Introduce design and measures before interpretation. Select principal patterns, negative findings, useful magnitudes and uncertainty without retelling every cell. Explain a negative result here through an established analytical relation or recorded diagnostic when available; otherwise leave the cause unresolved. Synthetic example explains data generation, observations, independent replication, fixed/varied settings, comparators, measures and reference truth/error. Code-specific agreement and engineering checks remain in the protocol or implementation reader unless essential to the comparison; keep pilots and finite checks distinct from principal repeated-simulation results. Performance addresses the target or decision benefit and return/failure behavior; analytical informativeness can belong here. Computation selects measured method costs and included operations, with convergence only if recorded; managed budgets and execution accounting stay in history. Tuning separates permitted settings from investigated sensitivity; robustness explains the justified generator/observation change beside its results. Do not invent evidence or duplicate actual-data absence, which has its own disposition.

limitation_markdown.description: Distinct continuation after the exhibit: the evidence or claim boundary limiting this comparison. Keep a qualification that changes a claim beside that claim. Do not retell the primary result or its explanation, or list every unperformed study. Display-routing or platform availability is not a scientific limitation. Keep missing, failed and unstarted work distinct and truthful.

implication_markdown.description: Distinct continuation after the exhibit: what the observed comparison implies for interpretation, intended use or next work under the tested conditions. Link the primary account or shared exhibit rather than repeating its numbers or full explanation. Do not authorize a run or infer a researcher preference.

question_ids.description: Exact effective protocol.claim_tests[].test_id values covered by this decision dimension, including prospectively added_tests. Use the same identifiers as analyst question_results and lead question_reviews; do not invent aliases. A test may support more than one topic.

exhibit_ids.description: List every exact same-evaluation table/figure ID interpreted by this topic, including shared exhibits also listed by another topic, selected from existing analyst exhibits. The first coverage entry declaring an exhibit owns its display; later entries show a link. Put the intended primary entry first. Keep exhibit IDs and placement instructions in structured fields, not prose. Empty only when no observed exhibit applies. Optional for retained accounts. This routes complete exhibits without changing values, scope or interpretation; related exact questions may share them.

headline_exhibit_ids.description: Verified table/figure exhibits from this evaluation that support the overall result, in preferred order within Experiments and Results. Empty when no observed numerical result is available. Summary contains no exhibits. Detailed answers link to an exhibit's home in Experiments and Results.

method_recap_markdown.description: Authored visible short recap of the exact implemented target and main mechanism around its essential equation, connecting them to the finding and decisive condition. Follow the supplied scientific-explanation reference and define essential symbols locally. Cite the frozen method/implementation sources. The complete procedure belongs in method_formulation_markdown and method/implementation readers; do not compress it into this recap, extract it heuristically or create new mathematics.

notation_markdown.description: Historical Markdown lookup. Under project_notation_v1 omit this field and adopt additions through notation_updates; the harness generates the exact account lookup. For retained catalogs without that capability, use only recurring mathematical symbols already used in the scientific account: symbol, definition, scientific meaning and relevant units. Exclude ordinary metric names, abbreviations, software terms and computational cost; explain measures in full beside the results and do not invent symbols merely to populate this table. Keep essential meanings visible at first use. Preserve distinctions between target risk, implemented bound, numerical reference error and repeated-experiment uncertainty where applicable. No historical glossary is inferred.

question_reviews.description: Exactly one review for each effective protocol.claim_tests[].test_id, including prospectively added_tests. Preserve the analyst's exact question identifiers; do not merge tests or replace them with aliases.

question_id.description: The exact effective protocol.claim_tests[].test_id reviewed here, matching the analyst result's question_id. This is the existing protocol identifier, not a new question alias.

review_markdown.description: Assess the Analyst answer against retained evidence, stating support, consequence and unique qualifications and disagreements, with attribution. A concise concurrence may link to the primary account. Retain applicable uncertainty and limitations; do not repeat the whole table, create a missing contrast or imply independent review of later Lead bytes.

theorist_findings_markdown.description: Applicable independent Theorist qualification or disagreement and its consequence for this exact test, with attribution and source. A short concurrence is sufficient when the audit adds no qualification. Do not copy the primary answer or imply review of later Lead bytes.

next_steps_markdown.description: The next useful question and resolving work for this finding; reference the responsible phase and existing issue when applicable.

conclusion.description: The first visible Summary finding: state the principal finding for the scientific purpose, whether a comparison, return/failure rate or inconclusive result, with useful magnitude and applicable uncertainty. Include a tested failure or no-useful-output condition when it changes the practical assessment, and the condition that most limits interpretation for the research goal. Select what changes the assessment rather than every metric, experiment or the whole method. Follow the supplied summary and claims-and-evidence references. Never fabricate a result; execution success is not scientific support, and missing comparisons, failed attempts and synthetic-only support stay explicit. The fuller decision_summary.conclusion_markdown adds interpretation rather than duplicating this finding.
